say:1:1410543001:1.female: I still believe the dwarves' partnership with the Essail is more complicated than it seems. I'm worried this might stir up a political crisis.

say:2:1410543002:1.text: Based on what I've seen, I believe the dwarves in Brimstone Village aim to restore their kingdom.
say:2:1410543002:1.source_cn: 以我的观察，我担心深岩村的矮人们想要复国。
say:2:1410543002:1.male: Based on what I've seen, I believe the dwarves in Brimstone Village aim to restore their kingdom.
say:2:1410543002:1.female: Based on what I've seen, I believe the dwarves in Brimstone Village aim to restore their kingdom.

say:6:1410543005:1.text: Sorry. I didn't mean to eavesdrop, but since it concerns my kin, I have to explain.
say:6:1410543005:1.source_cn: 抱歉，偷听了你们的谈话，但毕竟跟我的同胞有关，我还是得...

say:7:1410543006:1.text: Eldric and his men aren't planning a rebellion—they just want to resurrect Helthor and regain magic.
say:7:1410543006:1.source_cn: 弗林那群傻小子们根本不想发动什么政变，他们只是想要复活...

say:8:1410543007:1.text: They believe that by doing so, they can restore the glory of the Ironheart Dominion and revive their <style="highlight">lost craftsmanship</style>.
say:8:1410543007:1.source_cn: 这样一来，他们就能够重新恢复千百年前的姿态，能够恢复钢...

say:9:1410543008:1.text: So, you're saying the dwarves' true intention is to push the boundaries of their craftsmanship and refine their skills?
say:9:1410543008:1.source_cn: 所以你的意思是，这些矮人，根本没想过复国，只是想追求工...

say:10:1410543009:1.text: It might be hard for you humans to understand, but yes.
say:10:1410543009:1.source_cn: 对于你们人类来说，可能有点难以理解。

say:11:1410543010:1.text: That is hard to grasp indeed...

say:12:1410543011:1.text: Don't worry about it. I'm here to talk about something else. While I don't think Eldric poses a real threat, this is a different matter...
say:12:1410543011:1.source_cn: 你不理解也没关系，我来找你们，是想说另外一件事。虽然我...

say:13:1410543012:1.text: Hey, Pointy Ears! Stop playing around and come listen!
say:13:1410543012:1.source_cn: 祭司小子！别玩了，你也给我过来听着！
